audience: suppliers that send quotes to public bodies and follow their acceptance in Chorus Pay

useCases.title: Track the quotes waiting for client acceptance
useCases.text: List the orders that still wait for the client to accept. Open one order to read its status and client.

useCases.title: Copy the payment link for a procurement team
useCases.text: Read an order to get its Chorus Pay link and status. Pass the link to the procurement team.

useCases.title: Create a quote for a public body
useCases.text: Create an order quote in draft status. The quote is not sent to the client. Repeating the same call does not create a second quote.

useCases.title: Update the redirect URL or metadata of an order
useCases.text: Change the redirect URL or the metadata of an order. Metadata keys you send are added or overwritten; other keys stay.

useCases.title: Cancel an order the client withdrew
useCases.text: Cancel an order in Chorus Pay. The client gets an email. The cancel fails once the invoice is filed on Chorus Pro.
